name: Nondetection

header.Components: V, S, M (a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

authored_intent: Touch willing creature, place or object no larger than ten feet in any dimension; consumed 25-GP diamond dust; eight-hour exclusion from Divination spell targeting and magical scrying perception.

rules.text: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from Divination spells.
The target can be a willing creature, or it can be a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.
The target can’t be targeted by any Divination spell or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
